recipe.title: Instant Pot Chicken and Brown Rice (One-Pot)

description.summary: Comforting one-pot Instant Pot meal with tender chicken thighs, brown rice, carrots, mushrooms, and a creamy savory sauce. Kid- and family-friendly, nutritious, and minimal cleanup. Perfect for busy weeknights or batch cooking. (Primarily Instant Pot; adaptable notes included.)

ingredients.ingredient: boneless skinless chicken thighs (or breasts, halved)
cream of chicken soup (homemade or canned)

preparation.step: Press Sauté on Instant Pot. Add olive oil and onion; cook ~3 minutes. Cancel Sauté.
Layer in this order: garlic, rinsed brown rice, chicken, carrots, mushrooms.
In a bowl, whisk together broth, cream of chicken soup, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Pour over ingredients in pot.
Place thyme sprigs on top. Seal lid, set to High Pressure / Manual for 25 minutes.
Quick release pressure carefully. Open lid, remove thyme stems, strip leaves into pot, and stir (shred chicken slightly if desired).

Serve warm. For meal prep: Portions reheat well; makes a big batch for lunches or family dinners. (Note: Primarily Instant Pot recipe; for crockpot adaptation try low 6-8 hrs with adjusted liquid, though results may vary.)
